description: Pierce County Planning and Public Works publishes GPS-located stormwater drain structures in unincorporated Pierce County, Washington. The inventory includes catch basins, manholes, curb inlets and catch-basin mechanical filters. It covers public and private features, with gaps where private gates prevent access. The native table metadata defines asset identifiers, structure type, dimensions, wall and lid materials, rim elevation, sump depth and service status, together with location-quality fields. These attributes support drainage-network representation and asset assessment. They do not establish hydraulic connectivity or calibrated flow behaviour by themselves. The public Socrata table is linked through the county catalogue, and its native field definitions are available as API metadata. The source points to county terms of use; no standard open licence is established here. Field completeness and survey accuracy remain unverified. The related network-structures record concerns water-storage and treatment structures such as detention vaults.
